name: Syncart. Product features
description: Syncart submodule adding paragraph-based product features/upsells: a product_feature paragraph and product type, an order-item bundle carrying a JSON field, and a Commerce order processor that applies a syncart_product_feature adjustment.
project_description: Product-feature submodule of Syncart. Adds a product_feature paragraph type and commerce_product/order_item bundles, a field_json data field, a CartService, and a commerce_order.order_processor that adds a syncart_product_feature adjustment to the order total.
